agent_explanation: Actuated EW green is held indefinitely despite max_green_seconds=87 and opposite demand. With detector_fail on E (t203 duration159), the controller fails to enforce max_green/recalled termination for the EW phase: EW green starts ~150 and is still active at step 346 (~196s later, >2x max_green) while NS queues grow and wait times exceed 200s. Removing the detector_fail restores normal cycling and eliminates the violation, confirming the interaction between actuated logic and detector_fail handling causes starvation.
